concerns.text: FR-009 cross‑references SC‑009 (a Success Criterion) instead of a User Story or appropriate source; functional requirements should reference the source of the requirement (e.g., a user story or design spec), not a success‑criteria metric definition.

Inconsistent terminology for the physics teacher signal: both “physics‑teacher” (with hyphen) and “physics teacher” (without hyphen) are used interchangeably, which may cause ambiguity in traceability and downstream tooling.
